gemini.title: Volunteers Csoed3
gemini.abstract: Volunteers Csoed3 is an authoritative dataset published by Central Statistics Office Ireland. It contains records relating to volunteers csoed3.
gemini.lineage: Published by Central Statistics Office Ireland as open statistics and census data. Loaded into Systra PostGIS database without transformation.
